request_approval.description: Pause the run until a person answers: approves, picks an option or gives input only a human can. They get an email and a notification with a link, and can answer without an account.
request_approval.name: request_approval

parameters.description: The question people see first, in one line, for example: Post this thread? or Pay @bill.vendor $@bill.total for invoice @bill.number?
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: Everything people need to answer: amounts, line items, what you need and in what form, and links to the source documents. Links are clickable in the email and the app.
parameters.name: details

parameters.description: Something to check before it goes out, such as an email or a post. They can change it before they answer, and the next steps get it as they left it.
parameters.name: draft

parameters.description: What they press to answer, main one first: Approve and Reject, Post it and Skip, or just Submit. Up to 6.
parameters.name: buttons

parameters.description: Whether they write something too: a note, or an answer you need.
parameters.name: written_answer

parameters.description: Email addresses of the people to ask, separated by commas. People in this workspace answer in the app; anyone else gets a secure link by email, so a client can answer without an account. Leave empty to let anyone in the workspace who can run workflows answer.
parameters.name: approvers

parameters.description: Only the people asked, the people asked plus the workspace's owner and admins, or anyone in the workspace who can run workflows (not Viewers).
parameters.name: approver_group

parameters.description: How long to wait for an answer. Leave empty for 72 hours; at most 720 (30 days). Hours can be fractions, for example 0.5 for half an hour.
parameters.name: time_limit_hours

parameters.description: A button to press for them, such as Skip. Leave empty to stop the run.
parameters.name: timeout_answer

parameters.description: Remind the people asked this often while the request waits (at most 10 reminders). Leave empty for no reminders. Hours can be fractions, for example 0.5 for half an hour.
parameters.name: remind_every_hours

parameters.description: If nobody has answered after this long, also ask the people in Escalate to. Must be shorter than the time limit. Hours can be fractions, for example 0.5 for half an hour.
parameters.name: escalate_after_hours

parameters.description: Email addresses to escalate to, separated by commas. Leave empty to escalate to the workspace's owner and admins.
parameters.name: escalate_to

parameters.description: The person the run runs as can't answer it: whoever started it, or the workflow's owner for scheduled and triggered runs.
parameters.name: require_different_approver

parameters.description: Email addresses of whoever prepared this item, for example the person who entered the bill. They can't answer it.
parameters.name: prepared_by

parameters.description: A channel ID or #name to post the request to, with a link to answer. Uses this workspace's Slack connection; the Lodol app must be in the channel.
parameters.name: slack_channel

returns.description: The answer: the button pressed, anything written, the text as they left it, and who answered and when.

answer.description: The button pressed, exactly as the step labels it: Approve or Reject on an approval, one of the step's own buttons otherwise, or the one chosen for when time runs out. Empty for a written reply and when nobody answered.

approved.description: True when the person pressed Approve.

comment.description: What the person wrote when they pressed Approve or Reject, if anything; reply holds it for any button.

decision.description: approved or rejected when the person pressed Approve or Reject, otherwise replied.

draft.description: The text to edit, as left: changed by the person or as the step gave it. Empty when the step gave no text to edit, and for a written reply.

reply.description: The written reply. Empty for an approval, and when nobody replied in time and the step was set to continue.

timed_out.description: True when nobody answered in time and the time-limit outcome was applied.

description: Pause a workflow until someone approves or rejects it, or until someone replies.
